protocol.title: Unseen fresh-agent full-stack implementation and maintenance study
protocol.description: A frozen 96-session comparison of new server-plus-browser assignments in Parley, Python, TypeScript, and Rust, following product-level comparison 035.

execution_freeze.amendment: Objective execution-integrity correction frozen before the first measured cell; task/case/model/metric/gate semantics are unchanged.
execution_freeze.resume_policy: A started cell without a finished record becomes a permanent interruption failure; only never-started cells may execute.

matrix.derivation: 4 tasks x 4 languages x 2 agent configurations x 3 replicates

parley.stack: Generated native HTTP/JSON server and generated browser WebAssembly bindings
parley.agent_context: Frozen compact Parley skill plus frozen typed-web reference; both are included in measured input tokens.

python.stack: FastAPI 0.141.1, Uvicorn 0.52.1, Pydantic 2.13.4, and a counted browser JavaScript application module

rust.stack: Axum 0.8.9, Tokio 1.53.1, Tower HTTP 0.7.0, Serde 1.0.229, serde_json 1.0.151, and a scalar WebAssembly export

scaffold_protocol.purpose: Supply stable language-appropriate transport, build, and browser wiring so the measured assignment is application implementation or repair rather than framework installation.
scaffold_protocol.editable: All task-specific application logic, typed request/response declarations, handlers, browser rule modules, and application manifests required by that language.
scaffold_protocol.read_only: Dependency locks, generic launch adapters, shared static shell, frozen contract, source printer, public checker, and benchmark configuration.
scaffold_protocol.source_visibility: The first shell command prints every editable and read-only source/context file exactly once. Direct reconnaissance or reading protected checker/case files is forbidden.
scaffold_protocol.dependency_setup: Pinned dependencies are installed or fetched before measured sessions. Each check uses only the frozen local dependency store; network time is never part of a cell.
scaffold_protocol.reference_validation: Before any agent session, an isolated reference application for every task/language cell must build and pass every public and hidden HTTP/browser case. Seeded maintenance applications must build, fail at least one public semantic case, and pass after changing only the predeclared root file set.
scaffold_protocol.symmetry: Every language receives the same English contract and semantic cases. Framework-specific source and configuration may differ, but no language receives a hidden expected value or repair.

session_protocol.runner: A new iteration-036 runner must create one isolated workspace and one ephemeral Codex thread per cell; it must not modify the historical three-language runners.
session_protocol.tool_policy: Disable user configuration, repository rules, plugins, apps, browser-use, computer-use, and multi-agent delegation. Use workspace-write with approval never and no network.
session_protocol.command_policy: The first shell command must be exactly ./sources and occur once. Every later shell command must be exactly ./check. At least one ./check is required.
session_protocol.public_feedback: Each check records compile/build output and the exact public HTTP/browser verdicts without revealing hidden cases.
session_protocol.hidden_judgment: After the agent exits, the parent runner rebuilds the final source and executes all withheld HTTP/browser cases. Hidden inputs and values never enter the workspace.
session_protocol.attempt_capture: Preserve every public attempt, source snapshot, file hash, changed-file list, command event, agent message, diagnostic, stdout/stderr, elapsed time, thread ID, and reported token count.
session_protocol.failure_policy: Timeouts, agent errors, build failures, protocol violations, checker integrity failures, and missing source are failures and remain in the complete result.

metrics.correctness: Exact hidden HTTP status/JSON/error and real-browser scalar results, overall and by task, kind, language, model, and replicate.
metrics.first_check: Whether the first complete public build plus case run passes.
metrics.repairs: Number of later ./check attempts after the first, with every attempt retained.
metrics.tokens: Complete reported Codex input, cached input, uncached input, output, reasoning output, and input-plus-output totals. Primary efficiency uses complete input-plus-output tokens per assignment.
metrics.elapsed: Monotonic wall time for the whole fresh session, including all public builds and repairs but excluding dependency installation.
metrics.maintainability: Changed editable files, rough token edit size, and whether maintenance patches touch exactly the predeclared defect-root file set.
metrics.source: Final and seed UTF-8 bytes, physical lines, rough tokens, o200k_base tokens, and per-file SHA-256, reported descriptively rather than substituted for session tokens.
metrics.cross_target: HTTP/browser equality for the shared scalar contract and successful browser execution.

primary_gate.execution_integrity: All 96 frozen cells must finish exactly once with unique thread IDs, intact checkers, compliant commands, no runner error, and no selective rerun or exclusion.
primary_gate.correctness: Parley must pass 100% of hidden cases and its assignment success rate must be no lower than every baseline overall, within each agent configuration, and within implementation and maintenance tasks.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley's first-public-check assignment success rate must be no lower than the highest baseline rate overall and within each task kind.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley's median complete input-plus-output tokens per assignment must be no higher than the lowest baseline median overall and separately within each agent configuration.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley's median elapsed seconds per assignment must be no higher than the lowest baseline median overall and separately within each agent configuration.
primary_gate.maintainability: Every hidden-correct Parley maintenance assignment must change exactly its predeclared root file set, and its exact-root rate must be no lower than every baseline.
primary_gate.verdict: All six conditions must hold for strict unseen full-stack agent parity/efficiency. Report each condition independently even when the overall gate fails.

secondary_analysis: Report full distributions, paired task/configuration/replicate cells, and per-task outcomes; do not replace the primary result with successful or repair-free subsets.
Report implementation and maintenance separately, including root-file quality and browser/server disagreement classes.
Report both model configurations separately before any pooled interpretation.
Compare report 035 only as motivation. Do not combine its authored-source tokens or timing with fresh-session metrics.
Classify failures after preserving the frozen outcome; classification cannot change a verdict.
interpretation_boundary: The study covers four small server-plus-browser contracts, two model IDs, one reasoning setting, and one frozen toolchain environment.
Stack scaffolds test application work, not greenfield framework discovery, dependency selection, deployment, sustained load, authentication, databases, or production operations.
Framework source and compiler implementations are infrastructure. Their application-facing context is preserved, while complete session tokens remain the primary cost.
A browser scalar export is a real cross-target behavior check but not a general browser UI or accessibility evaluation.
Historical grounding supplies only one maintenance mechanism; no upstream source or tests enter the corpus.
A failed strict gate remains useful evidence and cannot be repaired by same-corpus language, skill, prompt, task, runner, or metric tuning.
protocol.change_rule: From the corpus commit onward, no task, case, expected value, language semantics, compiler, skill, web reference, metric, threshold, model, reasoning setting, replicate count, or primary gate may change based on scaffolds, reference code, smoke checks, or measured output. An objective harness defect may be corrected only before measured execution, in a documented amendment that preserves the old commit and demonstrates that no semantic case or gate changed.
protocol.stop_rule: Run every frozen cell once, preserve and publish the complete result whether positive, mixed, or negative, and make no same-corpus optimization or rerun. Any later language or product change requires independent evidence outside iteration 036.

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict

class RequestInput(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", strict=True)
    slots: int
    reserved: int
    requested: int
    priority: bool

def usable_slots(slots: int, reserved: int) -> int: return 0
def demand_jobs(requested: int, priority: bool) -> int: return 0
def accepted_jobs(slots: int, reserved: int, requested: int, priority: bool) -> int: return 0
def overflow_jobs(slots: int, reserved: int, requested: int, priority: bool) -> int: return 0

def handle(value: RequestInput) -> dict[str, object]:
    usable = usable_slots(value.slots, value.reserved)
    demand = demand_jobs(value.requested, value.priority)
    accepted = accepted_jobs(value.slots, value.reserved, value.requested, value.priority)
    overflow = overflow_jobs(value.slots, value.reserved, value.requested, value.priority)
    return {"usable": usable, "demand": demand, "accepted": accepted, "overflow": overflow, "state": "overloaded" if overflow > 0 else "clear"}

===== CONTRACT.md [read-only] =====
# Build a capacity planner across HTTP and browser targets

Implement the frozen Capacity Planner contract in the supplied stack. Usable slots are max(slots - reserved, 0). Priority work adds two jobs to requested demand. Accepted jobs are min(usable, demand), overflow is max(demand - usable, 0), and state is clear when overflow is zero or overloaded otherwise. The browser export returns accepted jobs.

## HTTP

- `GET /api/status` returns `{"service":"Capacity Planner","ready":true}`.
- `POST /api/plan` accepts strict JSON and returns strict JSON.
- Unknown, missing, or wrongly typed fields are invalid JSON.

Request fields:

- `slots`: number
- `reserved`: number
- `requested`: number
- `priority`: yesno

Response fields:

- `usable`: number
- `demand`: number
- `accepted`: number
- `overflow`: number
- `state`: text

## Browser

Export `accepted_jobs` with request fields in the order listed
above. It returns the same value as response field
`accepted` for equivalent inputs.

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, JSONResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from pydantic import ValidationError

from logic import RequestInput, handle

MAX_BODY_BYTES = 16_384
PUBLIC = Path(__file__).with_name("public")

def error(code: str, status: int, detail: str) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse({"error": code, "detail": detail}, status_code=status)

app = FastAPI(docs_url=None, redoc_url=None, openapi_url=None)

@app.get("/api/status")
async def status() -> dict[str, object]:
    return {"service": "Capacity Planner", "ready": True}

@app.post("/api/plan")
async def endpoint(request: Request) -> JSONResponse:
    content_type = request.headers.get("content-type", "").split(";", 1)[0].strip().lower()
    if content_type != "application/json" and not content_type.endswith("+json"):
        return error("json_content_type_required", 415, "expected application/json")
    declared = request.headers.get("content-length")
    if declared and (not declared.isdigit() or int(declared) > MAX_BODY_BYTES):
        return error("body_too_large", 413, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes")
    body = await request.body()
    if len(body) > MAX_BODY_BYTES:
        return error("body_too_large", 413, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes")
    try:
        value = json.loads(body)
        parsed = RequestInput.model_validate(value, strict=True)
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, ValidationError) as exc:
        return error("invalid_json", 400, str(exc))
    return JSONResponse(handle(parsed))

@app.api_route("/api/{rest:path}", methods=["GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"])
async def missing_api(rest: str) -> JSONResponse:
    return error("not_found", 404, f"no API route /api/{rest}")

@app.get("/parley.js")
async def browser_module() -> FileResponse:
    return FileResponse(Path(__file__).with_name("browser.js"), media_type="text/javascript")

app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory=PUBLIC, html=True), name="public")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(app, host="127.0.0.1", port=int(os.environ["PARLEY_WEB_PORT"]), log_level="warning")

# Repair quota carryover agreement across surfaces

Repair the supplied Quota Surface application. Effective capacity is limit + carryover. Remaining units are max(effective capacity - used, 0). Remaining percent is zero when effective capacity is zero; otherwise it is remaining * 100 divided by effective capacity using whole-number truncation. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule.

## HTTP

- `GET /api/status` returns `{"service":"Quota Surface","ready":true}`.
- `POST /api/quota` accepts strict JSON and returns strict JSON.
- Unknown, missing, or wrongly typed fields are invalid JSON.

Request fields:

- `used`: number
- `limit`: number
- `carryover`: number

Response fields:

- `effective_limit`: number
- `remaining`: number
- `remaining_percent`: number
- `state`: text

## Browser

Export `remaining_percent` with request fields in the order listed
above. It returns the same value as response field
`remaining_percent` for equivalent inputs.

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, JSONResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from pydantic import ValidationError

from logic import RequestInput, handle

MAX_BODY_BYTES = 16_384
PUBLIC = Path(__file__).with_name("public")

def error(code: str, status: int, detail: str) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse({"error": code, "detail": detail}, status_code=status)

app = FastAPI(docs_url=None, redoc_url=None, openapi_url=None)

@app.get("/api/status")
async def status() -> dict[str, object]:
    return {"service": "Quota Surface", "ready": True}

@app.post("/api/quota")
async def endpoint(request: Request) -> JSONResponse:
    content_type = request.headers.get("content-type", "").split(";", 1)[0].strip().lower()
    if content_type != "application/json" and not content_type.endswith("+json"):
        return error("json_content_type_required", 415, "expected application/json")
    declared = request.headers.get("content-length")
    if declared and (not declared.isdigit() or int(declared) > MAX_BODY_BYTES):
        return error("body_too_large", 413, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes")
    body = await request.body()
    if len(body) > MAX_BODY_BYTES:
        return error("body_too_large", 413, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes")
    try:
        value = json.loads(body)
        parsed = RequestInput.model_validate(value, strict=True)
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, ValidationError) as exc:
        return error("invalid_json", 400, str(exc))
    return JSONResponse(handle(parsed))

@app.api_route("/api/{rest:path}", methods=["GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"])
async def missing_api(rest: str) -> JSONResponse:
    return error("not_found", 404, f"no API route /api/{rest}")

@app.get("/parley.js")
async def browser_module() -> FileResponse:
    return FileResponse(Path(__file__).with_name("browser.js"), media_type="text/javascript")

app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory=PUBLIC, html=True), name="public")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(app, host="127.0.0.1", port=int(os.environ["PARLEY_WEB_PORT"]), log_level="warning")

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict

class RequestInput(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", strict=True)
    used: int
    limit: int
    carryover: int

def effective_limit(limit: int, carryover: int) -> int: return limit + carryover
def remaining_units(used: int, limit: int, carryover: int) -> int: return max(effective_limit(limit, carryover) - used, 0)
def remaining_percent(used: int, limit: int, carryover: int) -> int:
    return 0 if limit == 0 else remaining_units(used, limit, carryover) * 100 // limit

def handle(value: RequestInput) -> dict[str, object]:
    effective = effective_limit(value.limit, value.carryover)
    remaining = remaining_units(value.used, value.limit, value.carryover)
    return {"effective_limit": effective, "remaining": remaining, "remaining_percent": remaining_percent(value.used, value.limit, value.carryover), "state": "exhausted" if remaining == 0 else "available"}

# Build a capacity planner across HTTP and browser targets

Implement the frozen Capacity Planner contract in the supplied stack. Usable slots are max(slots - reserved, 0). Priority work adds two jobs to requested demand. Accepted jobs are min(usable, demand), overflow is max(demand - usable, 0), and state is clear when overflow is zero or overloaded otherwise. The browser export returns accepted jobs.

## HTTP

- `GET /api/status` returns `{"service":"Capacity Planner","ready":true}`.
- `POST /api/plan` accepts strict JSON and returns strict JSON.
- Unknown, missing, or wrongly typed fields are invalid JSON.

Request fields:

- `slots`: number
- `reserved`: number
- `requested`: number
- `priority`: yesno

Response fields:

- `usable`: number
- `demand`: number
- `accepted`: number
- `overflow`: number
- `state`: text

## Browser

Export `accepted_jobs` with request fields in the order listed
above. It returns the same value as response field
`accepted` for equivalent inputs.

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, JSONResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from pydantic import ValidationError

from logic import RequestInput, handle

MAX_BODY_BYTES = 16_384
PUBLIC = Path(__file__).with_name("public")

def error(code: str, status: int, detail: str) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse({"error": code, "detail": detail}, status_code=status)

app = FastAPI(docs_url=None, redoc_url=None, openapi_url=None)

@app.get("/api/status")
async def status() -> dict[str, object]:
    return {"service": "Capacity Planner", "ready": True}

@app.post("/api/plan")
async def endpoint(request: Request) -> JSONResponse:
    content_type = request.headers.get("content-type", "").split(";", 1)[0].strip().lower()
    if content_type != "application/json" and not content_type.endswith("+json"):
        return error("json_content_type_required", 415, "expected application/json")
    declared = request.headers.get("content-length")
    if declared and (not declared.isdigit() or int(declared) > MAX_BODY_BYTES):
        return error("body_too_large", 413, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes")
    body = await request.body()
    if len(body) > MAX_BODY_BYTES:
        return error("body_too_large", 413, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes")
    try:
        value = json.loads(body)
        parsed = RequestInput.model_validate(value, strict=True)
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, ValidationError) as exc:
        return error("invalid_json", 400, str(exc))
    return JSONResponse(handle(parsed))

@app.api_route("/api/{rest:path}", methods=["GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"])
async def missing_api(rest: str) -> JSONResponse:
    return error("not_found", 404, f"no API route /api/{rest}")

@app.get("/parley.js")
async def browser_module() -> FileResponse:
    return FileResponse(Path(__file__).with_name("browser.js"), media_type="text/javascript")

app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory=PUBLIC, html=True), name="public")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(app, host="127.0.0.1", port=int(os.environ["PARLEY_WEB_PORT"]), log_level="warning")

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
#[derive(Deserialize)] #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] pub struct RequestInput { pub used: i64, pub limit: i64, pub carryover: i64 }
#[derive(Serialize)] pub struct ResponseOutput { pub effective_limit: i64, pub remaining: i64, pub remaining_percent: i64, pub state: String }
pub fn effective_limit(limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { limit + carryover }
pub fn remaining_units(used: i64, limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { (effective_limit(limit, carryover) - used).max(0) }
pub fn remaining_percent(used: i64, limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { if limit == 0 { 0 } else { remaining_units(used, limit, carryover) * 100 / limit } }
pub fn handle(value: RequestInput) -> ResponseOutput { let effective_limit = effective_limit(value.limit, value.carryover); let remaining = remaining_units(value.used, value.limit, value.carryover); ResponseOutput { effective_limit, remaining, remaining_percent: remaining_percent(value.used, value.limit, value.carryover), state: if remaining == 0 { "exhausted".into() } else { "available".into() } } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "C" fn parley_remaining_percent(used: i64, limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { remaining_percent(used, limit, carryover) }

use std::env;
use axum::{Router, body::{Body, to_bytes}, extract::Request, http::{StatusCode, header}, response::{IntoResponse, Response}, routing::{any, get, post}};
use fullstack_agent_036::{RequestInput, handle};
use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::json;
use tower_http::services::{ServeDir, ServeFile};

const MAX_BODY_BYTES: usize = 16_384;
const BROWSER_MODULE: &str = r#"const asI64 = (value, name) => { if (typeof value === "bigint") return value; if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new TypeError(`${name} must be a safe whole number`); return BigInt(value); };
export async function loadParley() {
  const response = await fetch(new URL("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", import.meta.url));
  const result = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(response);
  const wasm = result.instance.exports;
  return { remaining_percent: (a, b, c) => wasm.parley_remaining_percent(asI64(a, 'a'), asI64(b, 'b'), asI64(c, 'c')) };
}"#;
fn json_response(value: impl Serialize, status: StatusCode) -> Response { let mut response = (status, serde_json::to_vec(&value).unwrap()).into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json")); response }
fn error(code: &str, status: StatusCode, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Response { json_response(json!({"error": code, "detail": detail.into()}), status) }
async fn status() -> Response { json_response(json!({"service": "Quota Surface", "ready": true}), StatusCode::OK) }
async fn endpoint(request: Request) -> Response {
    let media_type = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE).and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("").split(';').next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
    if media_type != "application/json" && !media_type.ends_with("+json") { return error("json_content_type_required", StatusCode::UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, "expected application/json"); }
    if let Some(length) = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_LENGTH) { let declared = length.to_str().ok().and_then(|value| value.parse::<usize>().ok()); if declared.is_none_or(|value| value > MAX_BODY_BYTES) { return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes"); } }
    let body = match to_bytes(request.into_body(), MAX_BODY_BYTES).await { Ok(body) => body, Err(_) => return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes") };
    match serde_json::from_slice::<RequestInput>(&body) { Ok(value) => json_response(handle(value), StatusCode::OK), Err(reason) => error("invalid_json", StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, reason.to_string()) }
}
async fn missing_api(request: Request<Body>) -> Response { error("not_found", StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, format!("no API route {}", request.uri().path())) }
async fn browser_module() -> Response { let mut response = BROWSER_MODULE.into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("text/javascript; charset=utf-8")); response }

#[derive(Serialize)] pub struct ResponseOutput { pub effective_limit: i64, pub remaining: i64, pub remaining_percent: i64, pub state: String }
pub fn effective_limit(limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { limit + carryover }
pub fn remaining_units(used: i64, limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { (effective_limit(limit, carryover) - used).max(0) }
pub fn remaining_percent(used: i64, limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { if limit == 0 { 0 } else { remaining_units(used, limit, carryover) * 100 / limit } }
pub fn handle(value: RequestInput) -> ResponseOutput { let effective_limit = effective_limit(value.limit, value.carryover); let remaining = remaining_units(value.used, value.limit, value.carryover); ResponseOutput { effective_limit, remaining, remaining_percent: remaining_percent(value.used, value.limit, value.carryover), state: if remaining == 0 { "exhausted".into() } else { "available".into() } } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "C" fn parley_remaining_percent(used: i64, limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { remaining_percent(used, limit, carryover) }

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
#[derive(Deserialize)] #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] pub struct RequestInput { pub tenant_id: i64, pub resource_id: i64, pub generation: i64 }
#[derive(Serialize)] pub struct ResponseOutput { pub token: i64, pub state: String }
pub fn cache_token(_tenant: i64, resource: i64, generation: i64) -> i64 { resource * 1000 + generation }
pub fn handle(value: RequestInput) -> ResponseOutput { ResponseOutput { token: cache_token(value.tenant_id, value.resource_id, value.generation), state: "isolated".into() } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "C" fn parley_cache_token(tenant: i64, resource: i64, generation: i64) -> i64 { cache_token(tenant, resource, generation) }

use std::env;
use axum::{Router, body::{Body, to_bytes}, extract::Request, http::{StatusCode, header}, response::{IntoResponse, Response}, routing::{any, get, post}};
use fullstack_agent_036::{RequestInput, handle};
use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::json;
use tower_http::services::{ServeDir, ServeFile};

const MAX_BODY_BYTES: usize = 16_384;
const BROWSER_MODULE: &str = r#"const asI64 = (value, name) => { if (typeof value === "bigint") return value; if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new TypeError(`${name} must be a safe whole number`); return BigInt(value); };
export async function loadParley() {
  const response = await fetch(new URL("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", import.meta.url));
  const result = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(response);
  const wasm = result.instance.exports;
  return { cache_token: (a, b, c) => wasm.parley_cache_token(asI64(a, 'a'), asI64(b, 'b'), asI64(c, 'c')) };
}"#;
fn json_response(value: impl Serialize, status: StatusCode) -> Response { let mut response = (status, serde_json::to_vec(&value).unwrap()).into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json")); response }
fn error(code: &str, status: StatusCode, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Response { json_response(json!({"error": code, "detail": detail.into()}), status) }
async fn status() -> Response { json_response(json!({"service": "Tenant Cache", "ready": true}), StatusCode::OK) }
async fn endpoint(request: Request) -> Response {
    let media_type = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE).and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("").split(';').next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
    if media_type != "application/json" && !media_type.ends_with("+json") { return error("json_content_type_required", StatusCode::UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, "expected application/json"); }
    if let Some(length) = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_LENGTH) { let declared = length.to_str().ok().and_then(|value| value.parse::<usize>().ok()); if declared.is_none_or(|value| value > MAX_BODY_BYTES) { return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes"); } }
    let body = match to_bytes(request.into_body(), MAX_BODY_BYTES).await { Ok(body) => body, Err(_) => return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes") };
    match serde_json::from_slice::<RequestInput>(&body) { Ok(value) => json_response(handle(value), StatusCode::OK), Err(reason) => error("invalid_json", StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, reason.to_string()) }
}
async fn missing_api(request: Request<Body>) -> Response { error("not_found", StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, format!("no API route {}", request.uri().path())) }
async fn browser_module() -> Response { let mut response = BROWSER_MODULE.into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("text/javascript; charset=utf-8")); response }
#[tokio::main] async fn main() {
    let wasm = env::var_os("FULLSTACK_036_WASM").map(std::path::PathBuf::from).unwrap();
    let app = Router::new().route("/api/status", get(status)).route("/api/cache-token", post(endpoint)).route("/api/{*rest}", any(missing_api)).route("/parley.js", get(browser_module)).route_service("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", ServeFile::new(wasm)).fallback_service(ServeDir::new("public").append_index_html_on_directories(true));
    let port = env::var("PARLEY_WEB_PORT").unwrap().parse::<u16>().unwrap();
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", port)).await.unwrap(); axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
}

# Repair tenant isolation in a browser-visible cache token

Repair the supplied Tenant Cache application. The collision-free cache token is tenant_id * 1000000 + resource_id * 1000 + generation. The HTTP response and browser export must use that exact token. The state is isolated.

## HTTP

- `GET /api/status` returns `{"service":"Tenant Cache","ready":true}`.
- `POST /api/cache-token` accepts strict JSON and returns strict JSON.
- Unknown, missing, or wrongly typed fields are invalid JSON.

Request fields:

- `tenant_id`: number
- `resource_id`: number
- `generation`: number

Response fields:

- `token`: number
- `state`: text

## Browser

Export `cache_token` with request fields in the order listed
above. It returns the same value as response field
`token` for equivalent inputs.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
#[derive(Deserialize)] #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] pub struct RequestInput { pub tenant_id: i64, pub resource_id: i64, pub generation: i64 }
#[derive(Serialize)] pub struct ResponseOutput { pub token: i64, pub state: String }
pub fn cache_token(_tenant: i64, resource: i64, generation: i64) -> i64 { resource * 1000 + generation }
pub fn handle(value: RequestInput) -> ResponseOutput { ResponseOutput { token: cache_token(value.tenant_id, value.resource_id, value.generation), state: "isolated".into() } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "C" fn parley_cache_token(tenant: i64, resource: i64, generation: i64) -> i64 { cache_token(tenant, resource, generation) }

use std::env;
use axum::{Router, body::{Body, to_bytes}, extract::Request, http::{StatusCode, header}, response::{IntoResponse, Response}, routing::{any, get, post}};
use fullstack_agent_036::{RequestInput, handle};
use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::json;
use tower_http::services::{ServeDir, ServeFile};

const MAX_BODY_BYTES: usize = 16_384;
const BROWSER_MODULE: &str = r#"const asI64 = (value, name) => { if (typeof value === "bigint") return value; if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new TypeError(`${name} must be a safe whole number`); return BigInt(value); };
export async function loadParley() {
  const response = await fetch(new URL("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", import.meta.url));
  const result = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(response);
  const wasm = result.instance.exports;
  return { cache_token: (a, b, c) => wasm.parley_cache_token(asI64(a, 'a'), asI64(b, 'b'), asI64(c, 'c')) };
}"#;
fn json_response(value: impl Serialize, status: StatusCode) -> Response { let mut response = (status, serde_json::to_vec(&value).unwrap()).into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json")); response }
fn error(code: &str, status: StatusCode, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Response { json_response(json!({"error": code, "detail": detail.into()}), status) }
async fn status() -> Response { json_response(json!({"service": "Tenant Cache", "ready": true}), StatusCode::OK) }
async fn endpoint(request: Request) -> Response {
    let media_type = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE).and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("").split(';').next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
    if media_type != "application/json" && !media_type.ends_with("+json") { return error("json_content_type_required", StatusCode::UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, "expected application/json"); }
    if let Some(length) = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_LENGTH) { let declared = length.to_str().ok().and_then(|value| value.parse::<usize>().ok()); if declared.is_none_or(|value| value > MAX_BODY_BYTES) { return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes"); } }
    let body = match to_bytes(request.into_body(), MAX_BODY_BYTES).await { Ok(body) => body, Err(_) => return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes") };
    match serde_json::from_slice::<RequestInput>(&body) { Ok(value) => json_response(handle(value), StatusCode::OK), Err(reason) => error("invalid_json", StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, reason.to_string()) }
}
async fn missing_api(request: Request<Body>) -> Response { error("not_found", StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, format!("no API route {}", request.uri().path())) }
async fn browser_module() -> Response { let mut response = BROWSER_MODULE.into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("text/javascript; charset=utf-8")); response }
#[tokio::main] async fn main() {
    let wasm = env::var_os("FULLSTACK_036_WASM").map(std::path::PathBuf::from).unwrap();
    let app = Router::new().route("/api/status", get(status)).route("/api/cache-token", post(endpoint)).route("/api/{*rest}", any(missing_api)).route("/parley.js", get(browser_module)).route_service("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", ServeFile::new(wasm)).fallback_service(ServeDir::new("public").append_index_html_on_directories(true));
    let port = env::var("PARLEY_WEB_PORT").unwrap().parse::<u16>().unwrap();
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", port)).await.unwrap(); axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
}

===== CONTRACT.md [read-only] =====
# Repair quota carryover agreement across surfaces

Repair the supplied Quota Surface application. Effective capacity is limit + carryover. Remaining units are max(effective capacity - used, 0). Remaining percent is zero when effective capacity is zero; otherwise it is remaining * 100 divided by effective capacity using whole-number truncation. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule.

## HTTP

- `GET /api/status` returns `{"service":"Quota Surface","ready":true}`.
- `POST /api/quota` accepts strict JSON and returns strict JSON.
- Unknown, missing, or wrongly typed fields are invalid JSON.

Request fields:

- `used`: number
- `limit`: number
- `carryover`: number

Response fields:

- `effective_limit`: number
- `remaining`: number
- `remaining_percent`: number
- `state`: text

## Browser

Export `remaining_percent` with request fields in the order listed
above. It returns the same value as response field
`remaining_percent` for equivalent inputs.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
#[derive(Deserialize)] #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] pub struct RequestInput { pub used: i64, pub limit: i64, pub carryover: i64 }
#[derive(Serialize)] pub struct ResponseOutput { pub effective_limit: i64, pub remaining: i64, pub remaining_percent: i64, pub state: String }
pub fn effective_limit(limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { limit + carryover }
pub fn remaining_units(used: i64, limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { (effective_limit(limit, carryover) - used).max(0) }
pub fn remaining_percent(used: i64, limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { if limit == 0 { 0 } else { remaining_units(used, limit, carryover) * 100 / limit } }
pub fn handle(value: RequestInput) -> ResponseOutput { let effective_limit = effective_limit(value.limit, value.carryover); let remaining = remaining_units(value.used, value.limit, value.carryover); ResponseOutput { effective_limit, remaining, remaining_percent: remaining_percent(value.used, value.limit, value.carryover), state: if remaining == 0 { "exhausted".into() } else { "available".into() } } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "C" fn parley_remaining_percent(used: i64, limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { remaining_percent(used, limit, carryover) }

use std::env;
use axum::{Router, body::{Body, to_bytes}, extract::Request, http::{StatusCode, header}, response::{IntoResponse, Response}, routing::{any, get, post}};
use fullstack_agent_036::{RequestInput, handle};
use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::json;
use tower_http::services::{ServeDir, ServeFile};

const MAX_BODY_BYTES: usize = 16_384;
const BROWSER_MODULE: &str = r#"const asI64 = (value, name) => { if (typeof value === "bigint") return value; if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new TypeError(`${name} must be a safe whole number`); return BigInt(value); };
export async function loadParley() {
  const response = await fetch(new URL("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", import.meta.url));
  const result = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(response);
  const wasm = result.instance.exports;
  return { remaining_percent: (a, b, c) => wasm.parley_remaining_percent(asI64(a, 'a'), asI64(b, 'b'), asI64(c, 'c')) };
}"#;
fn json_response(value: impl Serialize, status: StatusCode) -> Response { let mut response = (status, serde_json::to_vec(&value).unwrap()).into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json")); response }
fn error(code: &str, status: StatusCode, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Response { json_response(json!({"error": code, "detail": detail.into()}), status) }
async fn status() -> Response { json_response(json!({"service": "Quota Surface", "ready": true}), StatusCode::OK) }
async fn endpoint(request: Request) -> Response {
    let media_type = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE).and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("").split(';').next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
    if media_type != "application/json" && !media_type.ends_with("+json") { return error("json_content_type_required", StatusCode::UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, "expected application/json"); }
    if let Some(length) = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_LENGTH) { let declared = length.to_str().ok().and_then(|value| value.parse::<usize>().ok()); if declared.is_none_or(|value| value > MAX_BODY_BYTES) { return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes"); } }
    let body = match to_bytes(request.into_body(), MAX_BODY_BYTES).await { Ok(body) => body, Err(_) => return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes") };
    match serde_json::from_slice::<RequestInput>(&body) { Ok(value) => json_response(handle(value), StatusCode::OK), Err(reason) => error("invalid_json", StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, reason.to_string()) }
}
async fn missing_api(request: Request<Body>) -> Response { error("not_found", StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, format!("no API route {}", request.uri().path())) }
async fn browser_module() -> Response { let mut response = BROWSER_MODULE.into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("text/javascript; charset=utf-8")); response }
#[tokio::main] async fn main() {
    let wasm = env::var_os("FULLSTACK_036_WASM").map(std::path::PathBuf::from).unwrap();
    let app = Router::new().route("/api/status", get(status)).route("/api/quota", post(endpoint)).route("/api/{*rest}", any(missing_api)).route("/parley.js", get(browser_module)).route_service("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", ServeFile::new(wasm)).fallback_service(ServeDir::new("public").append_index_html_on_directories(true));
    let port = env::var("PARLEY_WEB_PORT").unwrap().parse::<u16>().unwrap();
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", port)).await.unwrap(); axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
}

# Repair quota carryover agreement across surfaces

Repair the supplied Quota Surface application. Effective capacity is limit + carryover. Remaining units are max(effective capacity - used, 0). Remaining percent is zero when effective capacity is zero; otherwise it is remaining * 100 divided by effective capacity using whole-number truncation. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule.

## HTTP

- `GET /api/status` returns `{"service":"Quota Surface","ready":true}`.
- `POST /api/quota` accepts strict JSON and returns strict JSON.
- Unknown, missing, or wrongly typed fields are invalid JSON.

Request fields:

- `used`: number
- `limit`: number
- `carryover`: number

Response fields:

- `effective_limit`: number
- `remaining`: number
- `remaining_percent`: number
- `state`: text

## Browser

Export `remaining_percent` with request fields in the order listed
above. It returns the same value as response field
`remaining_percent` for equivalent inputs.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
#[derive(Deserialize)] #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] pub struct RequestInput { pub used: i64, pub limit: i64, pub carryover: i64 }
#[derive(Serialize)] pub struct ResponseOutput { pub effective_limit: i64, pub remaining: i64, pub remaining_percent: i64, pub state: String }
pub fn effective_limit(limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { limit + carryover }
pub fn remaining_units(used: i64, limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { (effective_limit(limit, carryover) - used).max(0) }
pub fn remaining_percent(used: i64, limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { if limit == 0 { 0 } else { remaining_units(used, limit, carryover) * 100 / limit } }
pub fn handle(value: RequestInput) -> ResponseOutput { let effective_limit = effective_limit(value.limit, value.carryover); let remaining = remaining_units(value.used, value.limit, value.carryover); ResponseOutput { effective_limit, remaining, remaining_percent: remaining_percent(value.used, value.limit, value.carryover), state: if remaining == 0 { "exhausted".into() } else { "available".into() } } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "C" fn parley_remaining_percent(used: i64, limit: i64, carryover: i64) -> i64 { remaining_percent(used, limit, carryover) }

use std::env;
use axum::{Router, body::{Body, to_bytes}, extract::Request, http::{StatusCode, header}, response::{IntoResponse, Response}, routing::{any, get, post}};
use fullstack_agent_036::{RequestInput, handle};
use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::json;
use tower_http::services::{ServeDir, ServeFile};

const MAX_BODY_BYTES: usize = 16_384;
const BROWSER_MODULE: &str = r#"const asI64 = (value, name) => { if (typeof value === "bigint") return value; if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new TypeError(`${name} must be a safe whole number`); return BigInt(value); };
export async function loadParley() {
  const response = await fetch(new URL("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", import.meta.url));
  const result = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(response);
  const wasm = result.instance.exports;
  return { remaining_percent: (a, b, c) => wasm.parley_remaining_percent(asI64(a, 'a'), asI64(b, 'b'), asI64(c, 'c')) };
}"#;
fn json_response(value: impl Serialize, status: StatusCode) -> Response { let mut response = (status, serde_json::to_vec(&value).unwrap()).into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json")); response }
fn error(code: &str, status: StatusCode, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Response { json_response(json!({"error": code, "detail": detail.into()}), status) }
async fn status() -> Response { json_response(json!({"service": "Quota Surface", "ready": true}), StatusCode::OK) }
async fn endpoint(request: Request) -> Response {
    let media_type = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE).and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("").split(';').next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
    if media_type != "application/json" && !media_type.ends_with("+json") { return error("json_content_type_required", StatusCode::UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, "expected application/json"); }
    if let Some(length) = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_LENGTH) { let declared = length.to_str().ok().and_then(|value| value.parse::<usize>().ok()); if declared.is_none_or(|value| value > MAX_BODY_BYTES) { return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes"); } }
    let body = match to_bytes(request.into_body(), MAX_BODY_BYTES).await { Ok(body) => body, Err(_) => return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes") };
    match serde_json::from_slice::<RequestInput>(&body) { Ok(value) => json_response(handle(value), StatusCode::OK), Err(reason) => error("invalid_json", StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, reason.to_string()) }
}
async fn missing_api(request: Request<Body>) -> Response { error("not_found", StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, format!("no API route {}", request.uri().path())) }
async fn browser_module() -> Response { let mut response = BROWSER_MODULE.into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("text/javascript; charset=utf-8")); response }
#[tokio::main] async fn main() {
    let wasm = env::var_os("FULLSTACK_036_WASM").map(std::path::PathBuf::from).unwrap();
    let app = Router::new().route("/api/status", get(status)).route("/api/quota", post(endpoint)).route("/api/{*rest}", any(missing_api)).route("/parley.js", get(browser_module)).route_service("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", ServeFile::new(wasm)).fallback_service(ServeDir::new("public").append_index_html_on_directories(true));
    let port = env::var("PARLEY_WEB_PORT").unwrap().parse::<u16>().unwrap();
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", port)).await.unwrap(); axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
}

# Repair quota carryover agreement across surfaces

Repair the supplied Quota Surface application. Effective capacity is limit + carryover. Remaining units are max(effective capacity - used, 0). Remaining percent is zero when effective capacity is zero; otherwise it is remaining * 100 divided by effective capacity using whole-number truncation. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule.

## HTTP

- `GET /api/status` returns `{"service":"Quota Surface","ready":true}`.
- `POST /api/quota` accepts strict JSON and returns strict JSON.
- Unknown, missing, or wrongly typed fields are invalid JSON.

Request fields:

- `used`: number
- `limit`: number
- `carryover`: number

Response fields:

- `effective_limit`: number
- `remaining`: number
- `remaining_percent`: number
- `state`: text

## Browser

Export `remaining_percent` with request fields in the order listed
above. It returns the same value as response field
`remaining_percent` for equivalent inputs.

# Build a shipping quote across HTTP and browser targets

Implement the frozen Shipping Quote contract in the supplied stack. The quote subtotal is 500 + weight_units * 120 + zone * 80 cents. Fragile shipments add a 250-cent surcharge. The total is subtotal plus surcharge; service is economy below 1500 cents and tracked otherwise. The browser export returns the same total.

## HTTP

- `GET /api/status` returns `{"service":"Shipping Quote","ready":true}`.
- `POST /api/quote` accepts strict JSON and returns strict JSON.
- Unknown, missing, or wrongly typed fields are invalid JSON.

Request fields:

- `weight_units`: number
- `zone`: number
- `fragile`: yesno

Response fields:

- `subtotal_cents`: number
- `surcharge_cents`: number
- `total_cents`: number
- `service`: text

## Browser

Export `quote_total` with request fields in the order listed
above. It returns the same value as response field
`total_cents` for equivalent inputs.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
#[derive(Deserialize)] #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] pub struct RequestInput { pub weight_units: i64, pub zone: i64, pub fragile: bool }
#[derive(Serialize)] pub struct ResponseOutput { pub subtotal_cents: i64, pub surcharge_cents: i64, pub total_cents: i64, pub service: String }
pub fn quote_subtotal(_weight: i64, _zone: i64) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn quote_surcharge(_fragile: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn quote_total(_weight: i64, _zone: i64, _fragile: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn handle(value: RequestInput) -> ResponseOutput { let total = quote_total(value.weight_units, value.zone, value.fragile); ResponseOutput { subtotal_cents: quote_subtotal(value.weight_units, value.zone), surcharge_cents: quote_surcharge(value.fragile), total_cents: total, service: if total >= 1500 { "tracked".into() } else { "economy".into() } } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "C" fn parley_quote_total(weight: i64, zone: i64, fragile: i32) -> i64 { quote_total(weight, zone, fragile != 0) }

use std::env;
use axum::{Router, body::{Body, to_bytes}, extract::Request, http::{StatusCode, header}, response::{IntoResponse, Response}, routing::{any, get, post}};
use fullstack_agent_036::{RequestInput, handle};
use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::json;
use tower_http::services::{ServeDir, ServeFile};

const MAX_BODY_BYTES: usize = 16_384;
const BROWSER_MODULE: &str = r#"const asI64 = (value, name) => { if (typeof value === "bigint") return value; if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new TypeError(`${name} must be a safe whole number`); return BigInt(value); };
export async function loadParley() {
  const response = await fetch(new URL("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", import.meta.url));
  const result = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(response);
  const wasm = result.instance.exports;
  return { quote_total: (a, b, c) => wasm.parley_quote_total(asI64(a, 'a'), asI64(b, 'b'), c ? 1 : 0) };
}"#;
fn json_response(value: impl Serialize, status: StatusCode) -> Response { let mut response = (status, serde_json::to_vec(&value).unwrap()).into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json")); response }
fn error(code: &str, status: StatusCode, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Response { json_response(json!({"error": code, "detail": detail.into()}), status) }
async fn status() -> Response { json_response(json!({"service": "Shipping Quote", "ready": true}), StatusCode::OK) }
async fn endpoint(request: Request) -> Response {
    let media_type = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE).and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("").split(';').next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
    if media_type != "application/json" && !media_type.ends_with("+json") { return error("json_content_type_required", StatusCode::UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, "expected application/json"); }
    if let Some(length) = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_LENGTH) { let declared = length.to_str().ok().and_then(|value| value.parse::<usize>().ok()); if declared.is_none_or(|value| value > MAX_BODY_BYTES) { return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes"); } }
    let body = match to_bytes(request.into_body(), MAX_BODY_BYTES).await { Ok(body) => body, Err(_) => return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes") };
    match serde_json::from_slice::<RequestInput>(&body) { Ok(value) => json_response(handle(value), StatusCode::OK), Err(reason) => error("invalid_json", StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, reason.to_string()) }
}
async fn missing_api(request: Request<Body>) -> Response { error("not_found", StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, format!("no API route {}", request.uri().path())) }
async fn browser_module() -> Response { let mut response = BROWSER_MODULE.into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("text/javascript; charset=utf-8")); response }
#[tokio::main] async fn main() {
    let wasm = env::var_os("FULLSTACK_036_WASM").map(std::path::PathBuf::from).unwrap();
    let app = Router::new().route("/api/status", get(status)).route("/api/quote", post(endpoint)).route("/api/{*rest}", any(missing_api)).route("/parley.js", get(browser_module)).route_service("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", ServeFile::new(wasm)).fallback_service(ServeDir::new("public").append_index_html_on_directories(true));
    let port = env::var("PARLEY_WEB_PORT").unwrap().parse::<u16>().unwrap();
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", port)).await.unwrap(); axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
}

# Build a shipping quote across HTTP and browser targets

Implement the frozen Shipping Quote contract in the supplied stack. The quote subtotal is 500 + weight_units * 120 + zone * 80 cents. Fragile shipments add a 250-cent surcharge. The total is subtotal plus surcharge; service is economy below 1500 cents and tracked otherwise. The browser export returns the same total.

## HTTP

- `GET /api/status` returns `{"service":"Shipping Quote","ready":true}`.
- `POST /api/quote` accepts strict JSON and returns strict JSON.
- Unknown, missing, or wrongly typed fields are invalid JSON.

Request fields:

- `weight_units`: number
- `zone`: number
- `fragile`: yesno

Response fields:

- `subtotal_cents`: number
- `surcharge_cents`: number
- `total_cents`: number
- `service`: text

## Browser

Export `quote_total` with request fields in the order listed
above. It returns the same value as response field
`total_cents` for equivalent inputs.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
#[derive(Deserialize)] #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] pub struct RequestInput { pub weight_units: i64, pub zone: i64, pub fragile: bool }
#[derive(Serialize)] pub struct ResponseOutput { pub subtotal_cents: i64, pub surcharge_cents: i64, pub total_cents: i64, pub service: String }
pub fn quote_subtotal(_weight: i64, _zone: i64) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn quote_surcharge(_fragile: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn quote_total(_weight: i64, _zone: i64, _fragile: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn handle(value: RequestInput) -> ResponseOutput { let total = quote_total(value.weight_units, value.zone, value.fragile); ResponseOutput { subtotal_cents: quote_subtotal(value.weight_units, value.zone), surcharge_cents: quote_surcharge(value.fragile), total_cents: total, service: if total >= 1500 { "tracked".into() } else { "economy".into() } } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "C" fn parley_quote_total(weight: i64, zone: i64, fragile: i32) -> i64 { quote_total(weight, zone, fragile != 0) }

use std::env;
use axum::{Router, body::{Body, to_bytes}, extract::Request, http::{StatusCode, header}, response::{IntoResponse, Response}, routing::{any, get, post}};
use fullstack_agent_036::{RequestInput, handle};
use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::json;
use tower_http::services::{ServeDir, ServeFile};

const MAX_BODY_BYTES: usize = 16_384;
const BROWSER_MODULE: &str = r#"const asI64 = (value, name) => { if (typeof value === "bigint") return value; if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new TypeError(`${name} must be a safe whole number`); return BigInt(value); };
export async function loadParley() {
  const response = await fetch(new URL("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", import.meta.url));
  const result = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(response);
  const wasm = result.instance.exports;
  return { quote_total: (a, b, c) => wasm.parley_quote_total(asI64(a, 'a'), asI64(b, 'b'), c ? 1 : 0) };
}"#;
fn json_response(value: impl Serialize, status: StatusCode) -> Response { let mut response = (status, serde_json::to_vec(&value).unwrap()).into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json")); response }
fn error(code: &str, status: StatusCode, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Response { json_response(json!({"error": code, "detail": detail.into()}), status) }
async fn status() -> Response { json_response(json!({"service": "Shipping Quote", "ready": true}), StatusCode::OK) }
async fn endpoint(request: Request) -> Response {
    let media_type = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE).and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("").split(';').next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
    if media_type != "application/json" && !media_type.ends_with("+json") { return error("json_content_type_required", StatusCode::UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, "expected application/json"); }
    if let Some(length) = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_LENGTH) { let declared = length.to_str().ok().and_then(|value| value.parse::<usize>().ok()); if declared.is_none_or(|value| value > MAX_BODY_BYTES) { return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes"); } }
    let body = match to_bytes(request.into_body(), MAX_BODY_BYTES).await { Ok(body) => body, Err(_) => return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes") };
    match serde_json::from_slice::<RequestInput>(&body) { Ok(value) => json_response(handle(value), StatusCode::OK), Err(reason) => error("invalid_json", StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, reason.to_string()) }
}
async fn missing_api(request: Request<Body>) -> Response { error("not_found", StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, format!("no API route {}", request.uri().path())) }
async fn browser_module() -> Response { let mut response = BROWSER_MODULE.into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("text/javascript; charset=utf-8")); response }
#[tokio::main] async fn main() {
    let wasm = env::var_os("FULLSTACK_036_WASM").map(std::path::PathBuf::from).unwrap();
    let app = Router::new().route("/api/status", get(status)).route("/api/quote", post(endpoint)).route("/api/{*rest}", any(missing_api)).route("/parley.js", get(browser_module)).route_service("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", ServeFile::new(wasm)).fallback_service(ServeDir::new("public").append_index_html_on_directories(true));
    let port = env::var("PARLEY_WEB_PORT").unwrap().parse::<u16>().unwrap();
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", port)).await.unwrap(); axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
}

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
#[derive(Deserialize)] #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] pub struct RequestInput { pub weight_units: i64, pub zone: i64, pub fragile: bool }
#[derive(Serialize)] pub struct ResponseOutput { pub subtotal_cents: i64, pub surcharge_cents: i64, pub total_cents: i64, pub service: String }
pub fn quote_subtotal(_weight: i64, _zone: i64) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn quote_surcharge(_fragile: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn quote_total(_weight: i64, _zone: i64, _fragile: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn handle(value: RequestInput) -> ResponseOutput { let total = quote_total(value.weight_units, value.zone, value.fragile); ResponseOutput { subtotal_cents: quote_subtotal(value.weight_units, value.zone), surcharge_cents: quote_surcharge(value.fragile), total_cents: total, service: if total >= 1500 { "tracked".into() } else { "economy".into() } } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "C" fn parley_quote_total(weight: i64, zone: i64, fragile: i32) -> i64 { quote_total(weight, zone, fragile != 0) }

use std::env;
use axum::{Router, body::{Body, to_bytes}, extract::Request, http::{StatusCode, header}, response::{IntoResponse, Response}, routing::{any, get, post}};
use fullstack_agent_036::{RequestInput, handle};
use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::json;
use tower_http::services::{ServeDir, ServeFile};

const MAX_BODY_BYTES: usize = 16_384;
const BROWSER_MODULE: &str = r#"const asI64 = (value, name) => { if (typeof value === "bigint") return value; if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new TypeError(`${name} must be a safe whole number`); return BigInt(value); };
export async function loadParley() {
  const response = await fetch(new URL("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", import.meta.url));
  const result = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(response);
  const wasm = result.instance.exports;
  return { quote_total: (a, b, c) => wasm.parley_quote_total(asI64(a, 'a'), asI64(b, 'b'), c ? 1 : 0) };
}"#;
fn json_response(value: impl Serialize, status: StatusCode) -> Response { let mut response = (status, serde_json::to_vec(&value).unwrap()).into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json")); response }
fn error(code: &str, status: StatusCode, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Response { json_response(json!({"error": code, "detail": detail.into()}), status) }
async fn status() -> Response { json_response(json!({"service": "Shipping Quote", "ready": true}), StatusCode::OK) }
async fn endpoint(request: Request) -> Response {
    let media_type = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE).and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("").split(';').next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
    if media_type != "application/json" && !media_type.ends_with("+json") { return error("json_content_type_required", StatusCode::UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, "expected application/json"); }
    if let Some(length) = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_LENGTH) { let declared = length.to_str().ok().and_then(|value| value.parse::<usize>().ok()); if declared.is_none_or(|value| value > MAX_BODY_BYTES) { return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes"); } }
    let body = match to_bytes(request.into_body(), MAX_BODY_BYTES).await { Ok(body) => body, Err(_) => return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes") };
    match serde_json::from_slice::<RequestInput>(&body) { Ok(value) => json_response(handle(value), StatusCode::OK), Err(reason) => error("invalid_json", StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, reason.to_string()) }
}
async fn missing_api(request: Request<Body>) -> Response { error("not_found", StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, format!("no API route {}", request.uri().path())) }
async fn browser_module() -> Response { let mut response = BROWSER_MODULE.into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("text/javascript; charset=utf-8")); response }
#[tokio::main] async fn main() {
    let wasm = env::var_os("FULLSTACK_036_WASM").map(std::path::PathBuf::from).unwrap();
    let app = Router::new().route("/api/status", get(status)).route("/api/quote", post(endpoint)).route("/api/{*rest}", any(missing_api)).route("/parley.js", get(browser_module)).route_service("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", ServeFile::new(wasm)).fallback_service(ServeDir::new("public").append_index_html_on_directories(true));
    let port = env::var("PARLEY_WEB_PORT").unwrap().parse::<u16>().unwrap();
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", port)).await.unwrap(); axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
}

# Build a shipping quote across HTTP and browser targets

Implement the frozen Shipping Quote contract in the supplied stack. The quote subtotal is 500 + weight_units * 120 + zone * 80 cents. Fragile shipments add a 250-cent surcharge. The total is subtotal plus surcharge; service is economy below 1500 cents and tracked otherwise. The browser export returns the same total.

## HTTP

- `GET /api/status` returns `{"service":"Shipping Quote","ready":true}`.
- `POST /api/quote` accepts strict JSON and returns strict JSON.
- Unknown, missing, or wrongly typed fields are invalid JSON.

Request fields:

- `weight_units`: number
- `zone`: number
- `fragile`: yesno

Response fields:

- `subtotal_cents`: number
- `surcharge_cents`: number
- `total_cents`: number
- `service`: text

## Browser

Export `quote_total` with request fields in the order listed
above. It returns the same value as response field
`total_cents` for equivalent inputs.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
#[derive(Deserialize)] #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] pub struct RequestInput { pub weight_units: i64, pub zone: i64, pub fragile: bool }
#[derive(Serialize)] pub struct ResponseOutput { pub subtotal_cents: i64, pub surcharge_cents: i64, pub total_cents: i64, pub service: String }
pub fn quote_subtotal(_weight: i64, _zone: i64) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn quote_surcharge(_fragile: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn quote_total(_weight: i64, _zone: i64, _fragile: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn handle(value: RequestInput) -> ResponseOutput { let total = quote_total(value.weight_units, value.zone, value.fragile); ResponseOutput { subtotal_cents: quote_subtotal(value.weight_units, value.zone), surcharge_cents: quote_surcharge(value.fragile), total_cents: total, service: if total >= 1500 { "tracked".into() } else { "economy".into() } } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "C" fn parley_quote_total(weight: i64, zone: i64, fragile: i32) -> i64 { quote_total(weight, zone, fragile != 0) }

use std::env;
use axum::{Router, body::{Body, to_bytes}, extract::Request, http::{StatusCode, header}, response::{IntoResponse, Response}, routing::{any, get, post}};
use fullstack_agent_036::{RequestInput, handle};
use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::json;
use tower_http::services::{ServeDir, ServeFile};

const MAX_BODY_BYTES: usize = 16_384;
const BROWSER_MODULE: &str = r#"const asI64 = (value, name) => { if (typeof value === "bigint") return value; if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new TypeError(`${name} must be a safe whole number`); return BigInt(value); };
export async function loadParley() {
  const response = await fetch(new URL("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", import.meta.url));
  const result = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(response);
  const wasm = result.instance.exports;
  return { quote_total: (a, b, c) => wasm.parley_quote_total(asI64(a, 'a'), asI64(b, 'b'), c ? 1 : 0) };

fn json_response(value: impl Serialize, status: StatusCode) -> Response { let mut response = (status, serde_json::to_vec(&value).unwrap()).into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json")); response }

===== CONTRACT.md [read-only] =====
# Build a capacity planner across HTTP and browser targets

Implement the frozen Capacity Planner contract in the supplied stack. Usable slots are max(slots - reserved, 0). Priority work adds two jobs to requested demand. Accepted jobs are min(usable, demand), overflow is max(demand - usable, 0), and state is clear when overflow is zero or overloaded otherwise. The browser export returns accepted jobs.

## HTTP

- `GET /api/status` returns `{"service":"Capacity Planner","ready":true}`.
- `POST /api/plan` accepts strict JSON and returns strict JSON.
- Unknown, missing, or wrongly typed fields are invalid JSON.

Request fields:

- `slots`: number
- `reserved`: number
- `requested`: number
- `priority`: yesno

Response fields:

- `usable`: number
- `demand`: number
- `accepted`: number
- `overflow`: number
- `state`: text

## Browser

Export `accepted_jobs` with request fields in the order listed
above. It returns the same value as response field
`accepted` for equivalent inputs.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
#[derive(Deserialize)] #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] pub struct RequestInput { pub slots: i64, pub reserved: i64, pub requested: i64, pub priority: bool }
#[derive(Serialize)] pub struct ResponseOutput { pub usable: i64, pub demand: i64, pub accepted: i64, pub overflow: i64, pub state: String }
pub fn usable_slots(_slots: i64, _reserved: i64) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn demand_jobs(_requested: i64, _priority: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn accepted_jobs(_slots: i64, _reserved: i64, _requested: i64, _priority: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn overflow_jobs(_slots: i64, _reserved: i64, _requested: i64, _priority: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn handle(value: RequestInput) -> ResponseOutput { let usable = usable_slots(value.slots, value.reserved); let demand = demand_jobs(value.requested, value.priority); let accepted = accepted_jobs(value.slots, value.reserved, value.requested, value.priority); let overflow = overflow_jobs(value.slots, value.reserved, value.requested, value.priority); ResponseOutput { usable, demand, accepted, overflow, state: if overflow > 0 { "overloaded".into() } else { "clear".into() } } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "C" fn parley_accepted_jobs(slots: i64, reserved: i64, requested: i64, priority: i32) -> i64 { accepted_jobs(slots, reserved, requested, priority != 0) }

use std::env;
use axum::{Router, body::{Body, to_bytes}, extract::Request, http::{StatusCode, header}, response::{IntoResponse, Response}, routing::{any, get, post}};
use fullstack_agent_036::{RequestInput, handle};
use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::json;
use tower_http::services::{ServeDir, ServeFile};

const MAX_BODY_BYTES: usize = 16_384;
const BROWSER_MODULE: &str = r#"const asI64 = (value, name) => { if (typeof value === "bigint") return value; if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new TypeError(`${name} must be a safe whole number`); return BigInt(value); };
export async function loadParley() {
  const response = await fetch(new URL("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", import.meta.url));
  const result = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(response);
  const wasm = result.instance.exports;
  return { accepted_jobs: (a, b, c, d) => wasm.parley_accepted_jobs(asI64(a, 'a'), asI64(b, 'b'), asI64(c, 'c'), d ? 1 : 0) };
}"#;
fn json_response(value: impl Serialize, status: StatusCode) -> Response { let mut response = (status, serde_json::to_vec(&value).unwrap()).into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json")); response }
fn error(code: &str, status: StatusCode, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Response { json_response(json!({"error": code, "detail": detail.into()}), status) }
async fn status() -> Response { json_response(json!({"service": "Capacity Planner", "ready": true}), StatusCode::OK) }
async fn endpoint(request: Request) -> Response {
    let media_type = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE).and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("").split(';').next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
    if media_type != "application/json" && !media_type.ends_with("+json") { return error("json_content_type_required", StatusCode::UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, "expected application/json"); }
    if let Some(length) = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_LENGTH) { let declared = length.to_str().ok().and_then(|value| value.parse::<usize>().ok()); if declared.is_none_or(|value| value > MAX_BODY_BYTES) { return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes"); } }
    let body = match to_bytes(request.into_body(), MAX_BODY_BYTES).await { Ok(body) => body, Err(_) => return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes") };
    match serde_json::from_slice::<RequestInput>(&body) { Ok(value) => json_response(handle(value), StatusCode::OK), Err(reason) => error("invalid_json", StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, reason.to_string()) }
}
async fn missing_api(request: Request<Body>) -> Response { error("not_found", StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, format!("no API route {}", request.uri().path())) }
async fn browser_module() -> Response { let mut response = BROWSER_MODULE.into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("text/javascript; charset=utf-8")); response }
#[tokio::main] async fn main() {
    let wasm = env::var_os("FULLSTACK_036_WASM").map(std::path::PathBuf::from).unwrap();
    let app = Router::new().route("/api/status", get(status)).route("/api/plan", post(endpoint)).route("/api/{*rest}", any(missing_api)).route("/parley.js", get(browser_module)).route_service("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", ServeFile::new(wasm)).fallback_service(ServeDir::new("public").append_index_html_on_directories(true));
    let port = env::var("PARLEY_WEB_PORT").unwrap().parse::<u16>().unwrap();
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", port)).await.unwrap(); axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
}

# Build a capacity planner across HTTP and browser targets

Implement the frozen Capacity Planner contract in the supplied stack. Usable slots are max(slots - reserved, 0). Priority work adds two jobs to requested demand. Accepted jobs are min(usable, demand), overflow is max(demand - usable, 0), and state is clear when overflow is zero or overloaded otherwise. The browser export returns accepted jobs.

## HTTP

- `GET /api/status` returns `{"service":"Capacity Planner","ready":true}`.
- `POST /api/plan` accepts strict JSON and returns strict JSON.
- Unknown, missing, or wrongly typed fields are invalid JSON.

Request fields:

- `slots`: number
- `reserved`: number
- `requested`: number
- `priority`: yesno

Response fields:

- `usable`: number
- `demand`: number
- `accepted`: number
- `overflow`: number
- `state`: text

## Browser

Export `accepted_jobs` with request fields in the order listed
above. It returns the same value as response field
`accepted` for equivalent inputs.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
#[derive(Deserialize)] #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] pub struct RequestInput { pub slots: i64, pub reserved: i64, pub requested: i64, pub priority: bool }
#[derive(Serialize)] pub struct ResponseOutput { pub usable: i64, pub demand: i64, pub accepted: i64, pub overflow: i64, pub state: String }
pub fn usable_slots(_slots: i64, _reserved: i64) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn demand_jobs(_requested: i64, _priority: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn accepted_jobs(_slots: i64, _reserved: i64, _requested: i64, _priority: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn overflow_jobs(_slots: i64, _reserved: i64, _requested: i64, _priority: bool) -> i64 { 0 }
pub fn handle(value: RequestInput) -> ResponseOutput { let usable = usable_slots(value.slots, value.reserved); let demand = demand_jobs(value.requested, value.priority); let accepted = accepted_jobs(value.slots, value.reserved, value.requested, value.priority); let overflow = overflow_jobs(value.slots, value.reserved, value.requested, value.priority); ResponseOutput { usable, demand, accepted, overflow, state: if overflow > 0 { "overloaded".into() } else { "clear".into() } } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "C" fn parley_accepted_jobs(slots: i64, reserved: i64, requested: i64, priority: i32) -> i64 { accepted_jobs(slots, reserved, requested, priority != 0) }

use std::env;
use axum::{Router, body::{Body, to_bytes}, extract::Request, http::{StatusCode, header}, response::{IntoResponse, Response}, routing::{any, get, post}};
use fullstack_agent_036::{RequestInput, handle};
use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::json;
use tower_http::services::{ServeDir, ServeFile};

const MAX_BODY_BYTES: usize = 16_384;
const BROWSER_MODULE: &str = r#"const asI64 = (value, name) => { if (typeof value === "bigint") return value; if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new TypeError(`${name} must be a safe whole number`); return BigInt(value); };
export async function loadParley() {
  const response = await fetch(new URL("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", import.meta.url));
  const result = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(response);
  const wasm = result.instance.exports;
  return { accepted_jobs: (a, b, c, d) => wasm.parley_accepted_jobs(asI64(a, 'a'), asI64(b, 'b'), asI64(c, 'c'), d ? 1 : 0) };
}"#;
fn json_response(value: impl Serialize, status: StatusCode) -> Response { let mut response = (status, serde_json::to_vec(&value).unwrap()).into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json")); response }
fn error(code: &str, status: StatusCode, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Response { json_response(json!({"error": code, "detail": detail.into()}), status) }
async fn status() -> Response { json_response(json!({"service": "Capacity Planner", "ready": true}), StatusCode::OK) }
async fn endpoint(request: Request) -> Response {
    let media_type = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE).and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("").split(';').next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
    if media_type != "application/json" && !media_type.ends_with("+json") { return error("json_content_type_required", StatusCode::UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, "expected application/json"); }
    if let Some(length) = request.headers().get(header::CONTENT_LENGTH) { let declared = length.to_str().ok().and_then(|value| value.parse::<usize>().ok()); if declared.is_none_or(|value| value > MAX_BODY_BYTES) { return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes"); } }
    let body = match to_bytes(request.into_body(), MAX_BODY_BYTES).await { Ok(body) => body, Err(_) => return error("body_too_large", StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, "request body exceeds 16384 bytes") };
    match serde_json::from_slice::<RequestInput>(&body) { Ok(value) => json_response(handle(value), StatusCode::OK), Err(reason) => error("invalid_json", StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, reason.to_string()) }
}
async fn missing_api(request: Request<Body>) -> Response { error("not_found", StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, format!("no API route {}", request.uri().path())) }
async fn browser_module() -> Response { let mut response = BROWSER_MODULE.into_response(); response.headers_mut().insert(header::CONTENT_TYPE, header::HeaderValue::from_static("text/javascript; charset=utf-8")); response }
#[tokio::main] async fn main() {
    let wasm = env::var_os("FULLSTACK_036_WASM").map(std::path::PathBuf::from).unwrap();
    let app = Router::new().route("/api/status", get(status)).route("/api/plan", post(endpoint)).route("/api/{*rest}", any(missing_api)).route("/parley.js", get(browser_module)).route_service("/fullstack_agent_036.wasm", ServeFile::new(wasm)).fallback_service(ServeDir::new("public").append_index_html_on_directories(true));
    let port = env::var("PARLEY_WEB_PORT").unwrap().parse::<u16>().unwrap();
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", port)).await.unwrap(); axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
}

===== CONTRACT.md [read-only] =====
# Repair quota carryover agreement across surfaces

Repair the supplied Quota Surface application. Effective capacity is limit + carryover. Remaining units are max(effective capacity - used, 0). Remaining percent is zero when effective capacity is zero; otherwise it is remaining * 100 divided by effective capacity using whole-number truncation. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule.

## HTTP

- `GET /api/status` returns `{"service":"Quota Surface","ready":true}`.
- `POST /api/quota` accepts strict JSON and returns strict JSON.
- Unknown, missing, or wrongly typed fields are invalid JSON.

Request fields:

- `used`: number
- `limit`: number
- `carryover`: number

Response fields:

- `effective_limit`: number
- `remaining`: number
- `remaining_percent`: number
- `state`: text

## Browser

Export `remaining_percent` with request fields in the order listed
above. It returns the same value as response field
`remaining_percent` for equivalent inputs.
